name: -CHASE- Mikaiketsu Jiken Sousaka ~Tooi Kioku~
original_name: -CHASE- 未解決事件捜査課 ～遠い記憶～
source:
The Cold Case Unit of the 3rd Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department. Two detectives worked in the unit that never stepped outside: An eccentric, Shounosuke Nanase, and a self-proclaimed elite, Koto Amekura. Wasting away their hours with nothing to do was a regular occurrence, when suddenly they received a phone call.

An explosion that took place 5 years ago. “It was not an accident. It was murder.” A suspicious phone call from an unknown caller spurred them to re-investigate a cold case with no leads whatsoever. Was it really a murder case…? Interviewing the young man who caused the explosion was as good a place to start as any. “If the probability is not zero, then that means there’s a possibility!”

Nanase finally stirs into action.

The case that had been ruled only an accident…Time to CHASE the truth. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161022171054/http://aksysgames.com/chase/about]Official site[/url]]
translation:
东京警视厅第三分局冷案组。这个从不外出的部门里有两名侦探：古怪的七濑祥之介，以及自称精英的雨仓香都。他们经常无所事事地消磨时间，直到某天接到一通电话。

“五年前发生的爆炸，并不是意外，而是谋杀。”
一通来自陌生人的可疑电话，让他们重新调查这起完全没有线索的冷案。那真的会是一桩谋杀案吗？采访引发爆炸的年轻男子，无疑是一个开始。
“只要概率不是零，就意味着存在可能性！”

七濑终于开始行动。

那起曾被认定为意外的案件……是时候CHASE真相了。

（来源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161022171054/http://aksysgames.com/chase/about]官方网站[/url]）
